questions.question: Which of the meningeal layers forms the external protective covering and consists of dense connective tissue?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. Dura mater

questions.question: Histologically, the dura mater is primarily composed of:
options: An outer periosteal layer and an inner meningeal layer
An outer arachnoid layer and an inner pial layer
Simple epithelial cells and smooth muscle fibers
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. An outer periosteal layer and an inner meningeal layer

questions.question: In the spinal cord, the space separating the dura mater from the bone is known as the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Epidural space

questions.question: The arachnoid mater consists of a sheet-like membrane and a system of trabeculae that contain:
options: The subarachnoid space filled with cerebrospinal fluid
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. The subarachnoid space filled with cerebrospinal fluid

questions.question: What is the primary function of the arachnoid villi?
options: To return CSF from the subarachnoid space into the venous blood of dural sinuses
To protect the brain from mechanical external trauma
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. To return CSF from the subarachnoid space into the venous blood of dural sinuses

questions.question: Which of the following best characterizes the pia mater?
options: A delicate, highly vascular layer closely adhering to the brain and spinal cord surface
A cartilaginous layer lining the cranial cavity
An adipose layer separating the brain from the arachnoid mater
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. A delicate, highly vascular layer closely adhering to the brain and spinal cord surface

questions.question: The choroid plexus consists of folds of the pia mater covered by ependymal cells whose primary function is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Secretion of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)

questions.question: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) consists of all the following components EXCEPT:
options: Capillary endothelial cells with tight junctions
The basement membrane of endothelial cells
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D. Fenestrated capillaries with wide pores

questions.question: The auricle (pinna) of the external ear is primarily supported by:
options: Elastic cartilage covered by tightly adherent thin skin
Dense fibrous connective tissue and bone
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Elastic cartilage covered by tightly adherent thin skin

questions.question: The ceruminous glands found in the external auditory meatus are:
options: Modified sweat glands that secrete earwax (cerumen)
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Modified sweat glands that secrete earwax (cerumen)

questions.question: The middle layer (lamina propria) of the tympanic membrane consists of:
options: Collagenous and elastic fibers arranged in circular and radial patterns with fibroblasts
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Collagenous and elastic fibers arranged in circular and radial patterns with fibroblasts

questions.question: The auditory (Eustachian) tube connects the middle ear to the nasopharynx; its posterior third is bony, while its anterior two-thirds are supported by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Elastic cartilage

questions.question: In the internal ear, the bony labyrinth is filled with a fluid called ......., whereas the membranous labyrinth is filled with .......:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Perilymph - Endolymph

questions.question: The otolithic membrane overlying the sensory hair cells in the maculae of the utricle and saccule contains crystals made of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Calcium carbonate (otoliths)

questions.question: In the cristae ampullares of the semicircular ducts, the sensory hair cells are capped by a thick, gelatinous, cone-shaped structure known as the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Cupula

questions.question: The stria vascularis is located in the lateral wall of the cochlear duct and is responsible for:
options: Direct nutritional supply to the tympanic membrane
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Secretion of endolymph

questions.question: The supporting cells that bound the inner tunnel (Tunnel of Corti) within the organ of Corti are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Inner and outer pillar (rod) cells

questions.question: The stereocilia of the hair cells in the organ of Corti are embedded in a stiff glycoprotein structure called the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Tectorial membrane

questions.question: The receptor hair cells found in the maculae and cristae ampullares are categorized into:
options: Flask-shaped (Type I) and columnar (Type II) cells
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Flask-shaped (Type I) and columnar (Type II) cells

questions.question: The cochlear duct (scala media) contains ....... fluid, whereas the scala vestibuli and scala tympani contain ....... fluid:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Endolymph - Perilymph

questions.question: Which layer directly separates the subarachnoid space from the pia mater?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Arachnoid trabeculae

questions.question: Which part of the internal ear contains balance receptors responsible for sensing linear acceleration?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Utricle and Saccule (Maculae)

questions.question: What type of epithelial cells line the membranous labyrinth in the internal ear?
options: Simple squamous to simple cuboidal epithelium
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Simple squamous to simple cuboidal epithelium

questions.question: The supporting cells surrounding the hair cells in the cristae ampullares are known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Supporting (sustentacular) cells

questions.question: Which of the following structures separates the scala vestibuli from the scala media (cochlear duct)?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Vestibular membrane (Reissner's membrane)

questions.question: Upon which membrane does the organ of Corti rest within the cochlea?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Basilar membrane

questions.question: The cartilage supporting the auricle (pinna) specifically belongs to which type?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Elastic cartilage

questions.question: The external surface of the tympanic membrane is covered by:
options: Thin skin (epidermis continuous with external acoustic meatus)
Mucous membrane continuous with the middle ear
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Thin skin (epidermis continuous with external acoustic meatus)
